method: Temporal overlap + face-track confidence + interpolated facial-landmark mouth motion contrasted with upper-face control + conservative speaker consistency
match_score_interpretation: uncalibrated heuristic score; not a probability
limitations: Mouth-region motion is a heuristic, not lip-reading.
Head movement, camera movement, and lighting can affect motion scores.
Speaker diarization errors can propagate into Phase 7.
Manual ground-truth labels are required to measure actual identification accuracy.
Speaker-level consistency may be wrong for dubbing, voice-over, or diarization errors.
visual_character_id preserves the original visual-track assignment.
final_character_id and character_id represent the final speaker-level assignment.
raw_character_id and raw_matched_track_id preserve the original assignment when a correction is made.
A corrected speaker identity does not mean the visual track itself has been relabeled.
